claims.text: Check vit D + B12 levels Q1-2 yrs.
claims.quote: To detect nutritional deficiencies, levels of vitamin D and B12 should be checked every 1 to 2 years.

claims.text: Chronic diarrhea → loss of iron, B12 and other nutrients.
claims.quote: Chronic diarrhea can result in loss of iron, albumin, calcium, magnesium, fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, and K), niacin, folic acid, vitamin B12, and trace elements such as zinc, selenium, and copper.
